note: Rifle RD, White River NF: 35 miles north of New Castle on the Buford-New Castle Road (County/Forest Road 245) to Hiner Spring, then FR 601, FR 823 and FR 823.2A. Under a quarter mile from Meadow Lake, whose picnic area has a dock and boat ramp. Trash pickup, bear-proof food storage, several accessible sites; a staging area for the southwest Flat Tops trails. --Claude
summary: FS page + WRNF 2026 table: confirmed 20 FCFS sites, spurs to 50 ft (agency figure), vault toilets, no water, $25, not waterfront (<0.25 mi from Meadow Lake); added season 06-04 to 10-02 (2026 estimate). Note trimmed of field facts, route detail added from the FS directions.
flags: Max length 50 ft is the agency's own figure (FS page 'parking spurs of up to 50 feet' and the 2026 table '20/50''). Not on recreation.gov as a campground (POI only), so no catalog to compare.

Access: FS directions are 28 mi up CR 245 to Hiner Spring, then FR 601 3.5 mi, FR 823 2 mi and FR 823.2A 0.7 mi; no RV, clearance or 4WD wording on the page, and no White River NF alert or order names CR 245 or these forest roads.

Season wording conflict on the FS page itself: 'Typical open season dates are late May to early October' vs 'Seasons of Use: Late spring - Late Oct.'; the 2026 table says 6/4-10/2. Recorded the table.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront) confirmed by the FS page: 'less than 0.25 miles from Meadow Lake'. Note: the 2026 table lists Meadow Lake CG (10 sites, 16 ft max) separately; that is the lakeside campground, not this one.
Status: no closure posted; the 2026 season (to Oct 2) is over.
